marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to east 15 knots late this evening then
veering to southeast 20 early Saturday morning. Scattered flurries ending Saturday morning with a risk of
freezing drizzle. Periods of snow Saturday late in the day. Fog patches
dissipating Saturday afternoon. Visibility 1 mile or less in fog patches and as
low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures near minus 1. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text: Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less.<br/>
